answer_1.quote: We design a four-step pipeline for crafting context-aware instructions aimed at generating personalized and creative text with AI assistants ...
answer_1.outputs: personalized text responses such as emails, paper abstracts, essays, and other creative writings

answer_2.quote: We implemented traditional word overlap metrics such as BLEU and ROUGE-L, calculated using the evaluate library.

answer_3.quote: We employ GPT-4-turbo as a judge to assess generated content from multiple perspectives. This evaluation encompasses several criteria: personalization, alignment with the user profile, helpfulness, relevance, depth, creativity, and the level of detail.

answer_4.quote: Evaluations by LLMs have not yet been demonstrated to be infallible; consequently, we conducted human evaluations. Annotators were instructed to compare outcomes under various settings to those of the finetuned SLM, recording results as win/tie/lose.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare generated outputs across different settings and record win/tie/lose judgments.
